description: This file defines the PHP class Zend_XmlRpc_Client, which implements an XML-RPC client, handling communication with an XML-RPC server, including request creation, sending HTTP requests, and response handling. It also manages dependencies on related classes and proxies for remote method invocation.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Client
classes.description: A PHP class implementing an XML-RPC client for communicating with XML-RPC servers, managing requests, responses, and proxies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new XML-RPC client with the server URL and optional HTTP client.

methods.name: setHttpClient
methods.description: Sets the HTTP client used for network communication.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Retrieves the current HTTP client instance.

methods.name: setIntrospector
methods.description: Sets the introspector object for remote server introspection.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Returns the last XML-RPC request object.

methods.name: getLastResponse
methods.description: Returns the last XML-RPC response object.

methods.name: getProxy
methods.description: Provides a proxy object for calling namespaced XML-RPC methods.

methods.name: setSkipSystemLookup
methods.description: Sets the flag to skip system method lookups.

methods.name: skipSystemLookup
methods.description: Returns whether system lookup is skipped.

methods.name: doRequest
methods.description: Performs the given XML-RPC request and loads the response.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Performs a method call to the XML-RPC server with parameters and returns the result.

methods.name: _createRequest
methods.description: Creates a new XML-RPC request object for a method call.
